hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; h="$d/scripts/hooks"; if [ -n "$d" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 -I "$h/claude-code-record-edit.py"; fi; why="python3 is not installed"; [ -n "$d" ] || { why="CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset"; h="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/hooks"; }; bash "$h/record-edit-not-judged.sh" "$why" >/dev/null; exit 0

r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; t="$r/.claude/hooks/urzua-claude-code.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$t" ]; then exec python3 -I "$t" edit -- urzua harness run edit; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"urzua harness: the editor hook could NOT run (python3 or .claude/hooks/urzua-claude-code.py is missing), so this edit was not judged. Run: urzua harness status"}'; exit 0
